step1_analysis.description: A multi-input summing transconductor circuit used in an analog GFSK modulator. It sums currents from multiple differential pair branches into a common PMOS load to realize an analog differential equation.

paper_reference.title: An Analog GFSK Modulator in 0.35-um CMOS

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the transconductor.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V and tail biases at 0.7V, total current is approx 200-500uA.

Voltage Gain.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain from input to output.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_n / gm_p with diode-connected load. gm_n ~ gm_p.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode-connected PMOS load yields a gain close to unity (0 dB).

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_p / (2*pi*Cload). With Cload=50fF and gm_p=500uS, BW ~ 1.5 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Intrinsic bandwidth is very high; in application it would be loaded by a larger capacitor to set the 1.5 MHz pole.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, bandwidth, and transient swing of the summing transconductor.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Summing Transconductor Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N1 N4 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N4 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N5 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 N5 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 LABEL_NET_2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Supply and Biases
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN2 N2 0 1.8
VN4 N4 N1 0 ; Diode-connect PMOS load for stable DC operating point

VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.7
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.7

* Inputs
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9 ac 1 sin(0.9 0.1 1Meg)
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VN5 N5 0 0.9

* Load
Cload N1 0 50f

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N1)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(dc_gain-3) fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 2u
meas tran v_out_max max v(N1)
meas tran v_out_min min v(N1)
.endc
.end
